title: TELECOM
heroDescription: Reliable power for critical infrastructure. Keep your towers running with clean, silent energy storage that never fails.

intro.title: NovaConnect: Mission-Critical Power for Network Infrastructure
intro.description: NovaConnect is purpose-built for telecom towers and critical network infrastructure requiring 99.9% uptime. Replace diesel generators with silent, instant-response battery storage. Zero warm-up time, zero emissions, zero fuel costs. Reduce operating expenses by 70% while ensuring your network stays online 24/7. Remote monitoring and automated failover keep your towers running without manual intervention.

features.title: Zero Emissions
